datasets.name: unit_economics
queryLines:
SELECT
  endpoint_name,
  model_canonical,
  event_date AS usage_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) AS week,
  SUM(request_count) AS total_requests,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0), 4) AS cost_per_request,
  ROUND(SUM(latency_p95_ms * request_count) / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0)) AS p95_latency_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(error_rate_pct), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM
  ai_daily_rollup
WHERE
  cost_allocation_method = 'matched'
GROUP BY
  endpoint_name,
  model_canonical,
  event_date,
  week

datasets.name: genie_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  surface,
  genie_channel,
  genie_agent_id,
  distinct_users AS user_sessions,
  total_cost_usd,
  total_dbu,
  sql_executions,
  successful_queries,
  querying_users AS querying_sessions,
  avg_query_duration_ms,
  total_bytes_scanned,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', usage_date) AS week
FROM
  genie_daily_metrics
WHERE
  usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  AND surface != 'genie_code'

datasets.name: cost_sql
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  surface,
  billing_origin_product AS billing_product,
  endpoint_name,
  genie_channel,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', usage_date) AS week,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date) AS month,
  user_identity AS user_email,
  workspace_id,
  cost_usd,
  dbu_quantity
FROM
  ai_cost_fact
WHERE
  usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  AND billing_origin_product != 'GENIE'

datasets.name: ops_sql
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_date AS usage_date,
  surface,
  model_canonical AS model,
  endpoint_name,
  invocation_source,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) AS week,
  requester AS user_email,
  input_tokens,
  output_tokens,
  total_tokens,
  cached_tokens,
  latency_ms,
  status_code,
  CASE
    WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_error,
  CASE
    WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 100.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS error_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN input_tokens > 0 THEN COALESCE(cached_tokens, 0) * 100.0 / input_tokens
    ELSE NULL
  END AS cache_hit_pct
FROM
  ai_interaction_fact
WHERE
  event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  AND surface != 'platform_internal'

datasets.name: top_endpoints
queryLines:
SELECT
  endpoint_name,
  SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost
FROM
  ai_cost_fact
WHERE
  usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND usage_date <= :date_range.max
  AND billing_origin_product != 'GENIE'
  AND endpoint_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  endpoint_name
ORDER BY
  total_cost DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: cost_user_dist
queryLines:
WITH user_costs AS (
  SELECT
    user_identity,
    SUM(cost_usd) AS user_cost,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 10 THEN '$0 – $10'
      WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 20 THEN '$10 – $20'
      WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 50 THEN '$20 – $50'
      WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 100 THEN '$50 – $100'
      WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 200 THEN '$100 – $200'
      ELSE '$200+'
    END AS cost_bucket
  FROM
    ai_cost_fact
  WHERE
    billing_origin_product != 'GENIE'
    AND (
      :date_range.min IS NULL
      OR usage_date >= :date_range.min
    )
    AND (
      :date_range.max IS NULL
      OR usage_date <= :date_range.max
    )
    AND user_identity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    user_identity
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(user_cost) AS grand_total
  FROM
    user_costs
)
SELECT
  cost_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count,
  ROUND(SUM(user_cost), 2) AS bucket_total_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(user_cost) * 100.0 / MAX(t.grand_total), 1) AS pct_of_total_spend
FROM
  user_costs CROSS JOIN totals t
GROUP BY
  cost_bucket

datasets.name: genie_user_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  cost_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count,
  SUM(user_cost) AS bucket_total_cost
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      user_identity,
      SUM(cost_usd) AS user_cost,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 10 THEN '$0 – $10'
        WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 20 THEN '$10 – $20'
        WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 50 THEN '$20 – $50'
        WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 100 THEN '$50 – $100'
        WHEN SUM(cost_usd) < 200 THEN '$100 – $200'
        ELSE '$200+'
      END AS cost_bucket
    FROM
      ai_cost_fact
    WHERE
      billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND (
        :date_range.min IS NULL
        OR usage_date >= :date_range.min
      )
      AND (
        :date_range.max IS NULL
        OR usage_date <= :date_range.max
      )
      AND user_identity IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      user_identity
  )
GROUP BY
  cost_bucket

datasets.name: top_models_by_volume
queryLines:
SELECT
  endpoint_name,
  model_canonical,
  event_date AS usage_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) AS week,
  SUM(request_count) AS total_requests,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(request_count), 0), 4) AS cost_per_request,
  ROUND(AVG(latency_p95_ms)) AS p95_latency_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(error_rate_pct), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM
  ai_daily_rollup
WHERE
  cost_allocation_method = 'matched'
  AND model_canonical IN (
    SELECT
      model_canonical
    FROM
      ai_daily_rollup
    WHERE
      cost_allocation_method = 'matched'
    GROUP BY
      model_canonical
    ORDER BY
      SUM(request_count) DESC
    LIMIT 25
  )
GROUP BY
  endpoint_name,
  model_canonical,
  event_date,
  week

datasets.name: cost_per_token
queryLines:
SELECT
  model_canonical,
  SUM(total_cost_usd) AS total_cost,
  SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
  SUM(request_count) AS total_requests,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(total_tokens), 0) * 1000000, 2) AS cost_per_1m_tokens
FROM
  ai_daily_rollup
WHERE
  cost_allocation_method = 'matched'
  AND (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR event_date >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR event_date <= :date_range.max
  )
  AND model_canonical IN (
    SELECT
      model_canonical
    FROM
      ai_daily_rollup
    WHERE
      cost_allocation_method = 'matched'
      AND (
        :date_range.min IS NULL
        OR event_date >= :date_range.min
      )
      AND (
        :date_range.max IS NULL
        OR event_date <= :date_range.max
      )
    GROUP BY
      model_canonical
    ORDER BY
      SUM(request_count) DESC
    LIMIT 25
  )
  AND total_tokens > 0
GROUP BY
  model_canonical
ORDER BY
  cost_per_1m_tokens DESC

datasets.name: wow_cost_movers
queryLines:
SELECT
  endpoint_name,
  this_week,
  last_week,
  ROUND(this_week - last_week, 2) AS wow_change,
  CASE
    WHEN last_week > 0 THEN ROUND((this_week - last_week) / last_week * 100, 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS wow_pct
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      endpoint_name,
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN cost_usd
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) AS this_week,
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
            AND usage_date < current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
          THEN
            cost_usd
          ELSE 0
        END
      ) AS last_week
    FROM
      ai_cost_fact
    WHERE
      usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
      AND billing_origin_product != 'GENIE'
      AND endpoint_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      endpoint_name
  )
WHERE
  this_week > 0
  OR last_week > 0
ORDER BY
  wow_change DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ops_daily_top5
queryLines:
WITH top5 AS (
  SELECT
    model_canonical
  FROM
    ai_interaction_fact
  WHERE
    event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
    AND surface != 'platform_internal'
  GROUP BY
    model_canonical
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  event_date AS usage_date,
  CASE
    WHEN t.model_canonical IS NOT NULL THEN f.model_canonical
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS model_group,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM
  ai_interaction_fact f
    LEFT JOIN top5 t
      ON f.model_canonical = t.model_canonical
WHERE
  f.event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  AND f.surface != 'platform_internal'
GROUP BY
  usage_date,
  model_group

datasets.name: genie_success_rate
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', usage_date) AS week,
  SUM(successful_queries) AS successful,
  SUM(sql_executions) AS total_executions,
  ROUND(SUM(successful_queries) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sql_executions), 0), 1) AS success_rate
FROM
  genie_daily_metrics
WHERE
  usage_date >= :date_range.min
  AND usage_date <= :date_range.max
  AND surface != 'genie_code'
GROUP BY
  week
ORDER BY
  week

datasets.name: error_by_model
queryLines:
SELECT
  model_canonical AS model,
  COUNT(*) AS request_count,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 100.0
      ELSE 0.0
    END
  ) AS error_pct
FROM
  ai_interaction_fact
WHERE
  (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR event_date >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR event_date <= :date_range.max
  )
  AND surface != 'platform_internal'
GROUP BY
  model_canonical
HAVING
  COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY
  error_pct DESC

datasets.name: genie_kpi_accurate
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', usage_date) AS week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS distinct_users,
  SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd,
  SUM(dbu_quantity) AS total_dbu
FROM
  ai_cost_fact
WHERE
  (
    :date_range.min IS NULL
    OR usage_date >= :date_range.min
  )
  AND (
    :date_range.max IS NULL
    OR usage_date <= :date_range.max
  )
  AND billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND surface != 'genie_code'
  AND user_identity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  week

datasets.name: genie_code_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  user_identity AS user_email,
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(dbu_quantity) AS dbu_quantity,
  DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', usage_date) AS week
